title: Mapletree Industrial Trust Management Ltd receives 869K Mapletree Industrial Trust units as management fees
body: Mapletree Industrial Trust Management Ltd received 869,429 units of Mapletree Industrial Trust as payment of management fees, valued at S$1.881 per unit, or S$1,635,395 in total. Total interest rises from 35,292,698 units (1.23%) to 36,162,127 units (1.26%).
remarks_text: The percentage of unitholdings before and after the transaction is calculated based on 2,856,697,444 units issued.
change_reason: the issuance of new units to the Manager as payment of base fees

title: OUE Limited's deemed interest in First Real Estate Investment Trust rises after payment of management fees in 3.9M units
body: OUE Limited's deemed interest in First Real Estate Investment Trust rose after FRML received 3,944,778 units as payment of management fees. No units are held directly. Total interest rises from 974,908,641 units (45.92%) to 978,853,419 units (46.02%).
deemed_interest_text: Total of 3,944,778 Units were issued to FRML (as Manager of First REIT), a subsidiary of OUE, as payment of FRML’s management fee on 5 November 2026. As a result, FRML has a direct interest in 247,384,374 Units (the "FRML Units"). Clifford Development Pte. Ltd. (“CDPL”), a subsidiary of OUE, has a direct interest in 53,471,217 Units (the "CDPL Units"). OLH Healthcare Investments Pte. Ltd. ("OHIPL"), an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of OUE Healthcare Limited, which in turn, is an indirect subsidiary of OUE, has a direct interest in in 677,997,828 Units (the "OHIPL Units"). Accordingly, OUE has a deemed interest in (i) the FRML Units in which FRML has a direct interest in, (ii) the CDPL Units in which CDPL has a direct interest in and (iii) the OHIPL Units in which OHIPL has a direct interest in, amounting to a total interest of 978,853,419 Units.
change_reason: the receipt of Units by FRML as payment of its management fees

title: First REIT Management Limited receives 2.2M First Real Estate Investment Trust units as management fees
body: First REIT Management Limited received 2,226,656 units of First Real Estate Investment Trust as payment of management fees, valued at S$0.2739 per unit, or S$609,881 in total. Total interest rises from 243,439,596 units (11.47%) to 245,666,252 units (11.56%).
remarks_text: The percentage of unitholding is calculated based on 2,123,220,314 Units in issue before the change and 2,125,446,970 Units in issue after the change.

title: First REIT Management Limited receives 1.7M First Real Estate Investment Trust units as management fees
body: First REIT Management Limited received 1,718,122 units of First Real Estate Investment Trust as payment of management fees, valued at S$0.2018 per unit, or S$346,717 in total. Total interest rises from 245,666,252 units (11.56%) to 247,384,374 units (11.63%).
remarks_text: The percentage of unitholding is calculated based on 2,125,446,970 Units in issue before the change and 2,127,165,092 Units in issue after the change.
